message.content: With no visible swelling or respiratory infection, likely causes include cervical muscle strain or myofascial tension, often from posture, sleep position, stress, or recent upper-airway irritation. Noninfectious inflammation such as a minor mucosal sore from dryness, reflux, or mild trauma can cause sore throat and throat tightness. Enlarged but non-infectious lymph nodes or thyroid tenderness may be felt despite normal appearance. Check temperature, recent viral exposure, dental issues, or allergic irritation. If symptoms persist, consider evaluation for lymphadenopathy, thyroiditis, or muscular trigger points.
